Excalifont attribution and provenance

The canonical upstream metadata in references/Excalifont-Regular.woff2 states:

Copyright (c) 2024 by Excalidraw. All rights reserved.

Trademark:
Excalifont is a trademark of Excalidraw.

Designer / manufacturer / author attribution:
Your Own Font Foundry (Virgil); Ján Filípek / DizajnDesign (Excalifont, modifications)

Designer and manufacturer URL:
https://dizajndesign.sk

The delivered adapter fonts contain Excalifont-derived outlines produced by
this repository. Their internal font family names begin with “Excalifont Extended ML”.
The KaTeX_* strings in mathlive-fonts.css, filenames, manifests, and font-map
keys are CSS/runtime compatibility identifiers required by MathLive 0.110.0;
they are not the internal primary names of the delivered fonts.

MathLive/KaTeX font resources supply compatibility cmap mappings and renderer
structure only. Excalifont's native outlines, advances, and vertical metrics
are retained; the upstream font outlines and locally supplied reference
binaries are not redistributed. See KATEX_FONT_NOTICE.txt and
MATHLIVE_LICENSE.txt for the notices associated with those compatibility
resources.

OFL.txt contains the applicable Excalifont copyright declaration and the SIL
Open Font License 1.1 terms. The canonical Excalifont reference metadata does
not itself state a Reserved Font Name determination, so this package makes no
claim either way beyond preserving the trademark statement above.
